data.name: Ieethaar
data.gender_notes: Ieethaar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘Athr’, meaning ‘to offer’. This name refers to the act of sacrifice or offering, which is a central theme in Islamic tradition. Ieethaar is a name rich in spiritual significance, symbolizing devotion, generosity, and selflessness. The name Ieethaar carries the meaning “Offering, sacrifice” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ieethaar usually hope their child will grow to embody offering, sacrifice and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to offer one's actions, deeds, and time to Allah
data.etymology: Ieethaar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Offering, sacrifice.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ieethaar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: إيثار
in_arabic.long_meaning: إيثار هو مصدر من ثلاثة أحرف إيذار، والذي يعني التضحية من أجل الآخرين، والقربة إلى الله تعالى، ومصدره من الإيذار الذي يعني إعطاء العذاب، ولكن مع مرور الوقت أصبح يعني التضحية والبذل من أجل الآخرين، وله أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام حيث يُشجع على الإيثار والبذل من أجل الآخرين

in_urdu.name: 이ثار
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام عربي زبان کے لفظ إیثار سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے دوسروں کی خاطر قربانی دینا، اور اس کا استعمال اسلامی روایات میں بکثرت ہوا ہے،特別 طور پر نیک کاموں اور دوسروں کی مدد کرنے کے لیے

in_hindi.name: ईथार
in_hindi.long_meaning: ईथार नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्द إیثار से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है दूसरों के लिए त्याग करना, और इसका उपयोग इस्लामी परंपराओं में बहुत किया गया है, विशेष रूप से अच्छे कामों और दूसरों की मदद करने के लिए

in_pashto.name: ایثار
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم د عربي ژبې له کلمې إیثار څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده د نورو لپاره قربانی ورکول، او دا د اسلامي روایتونو کې ډېر کارول شوی دی، په ځانګړي ډول د ښې کارونو او د نورو د مرستې لپاره

data.cultural_impact: Ieethaar is a name with deep cultural resonance within the Islamic community, particularly in relation to the sacrifice of animals during the annual pilgrimage to Mecca known as Hajj. This momentous act signifies the commitment to the faith, and reinforces the importance of community and unity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ieethaar holds immense spiritual significance in Islam. It symbolizes selflessness and devotion, as the act of offering a sacrifice is an expression of one's surrender and submission to Allah. The giving of an offering represents the notion of giving back to the divine, as a means of expressing gratitude and love for the blessings God bestows upon us. In Islamic tradition, this act of sacrifice serves as a reminder of the prophetic legacy of Ibrahim, who, in his devotion to Allah, was prepared to sacrifice his son Ishmael when called upon to do so. Thus, the name Ieethaar embodies the selfless, generous, and unwavering spirit of submission to Allah, which is a cornerstone of Islamic faith and practice.
